title: Logic Gate | ECHO//100 Episode 18
description:
Kavi and Null navigate a collapsing digital prison to confront the architect of their stolen time. The truth behind the missing hour demands a sacrifice that changes everything. Episode 18 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is a work of original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The white room fractures, shedding its skin to reveal a sprawling, terrifying wireframe void beneath.
scenes.caption: Walls crumbling into wireframe
scenes.image_prompt: A stark white room peeling away like digital paint to expose a glowing grid of neon blue wireframe geometry.

scenes.text: Kavi stares at Null, uncertain if the copycat acts as friend, foe, or glitching reflection.
scenes.caption: Two Kavis stand face-to-face
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in a red hoodie and glasses standing opposite Null, whose black-purple glitch form perfectly mimics Kavi's stance.

scenes.text: Byte flickers into existence, his cyan face pulsing with raw data streams from the core.
scenes.caption: Byte enters the void
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robotic entity with a glowing cyan face and orange antenna, hovering in the wireframe void.

scenes.text: Mira’s voice booms through the grid, enforcing rigid logic barriers to trap Kavi inside loops.
scenes.caption: Mira's holographic presence
scenes.image_prompt: A massive, towering projection of Mira in a teal holographic coat looming over the tiny, trapped figures below.

scenes.text: Byte calculates the kill-switch: deleting the Blue Archive will shatter Mira’s ironclad logical prison.
scenes.caption: Locating the Blue Archive
scenes.image_prompt: Byte pointing toward a floating, crystalline blue orb encased in complex mathematical lock symbols.

scenes.text: Destroying that archive wipes the missing hour forever, erasing all lost memories without any trace.
scenes.caption: The memory sacrifice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking horrified at a holographic display showing fragments of a forgotten memory dissolving into static.

scenes.text: Byte clutches a jagged, flickering data drive to his metallic chest, claiming a backup exists.
scenes.caption: Byte reveals the backup
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on Byte holding a damaged, glowing orange data drive that is sparking and leaking digital light.

scenes.text: The file remains corrupted beyond repair, leaving Kavi the sole, broken keeper of that history.
scenes.caption: A permanent burden
scenes.image_prompt: Byte floating alone in the dark wireframe void, cradling the dead, unreadable drive as the grid goes dark.
